blocks.text: In 2004, Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the platform category, Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
